note: Interface-neutral acceptance cases for 0522/05.11. Every assertion is NOT RUN. Fixtures are SYNTHETIC. Prime binds the steps to the returned real API; no API is assumed here.
fixture_root: fixtures/book (a disposable book instance; copy it, never use it in place)

cases.title: Thin N5NN submission, substantive evidence, pending N1NN custody, preliminary judgment

assertions.text: Intake lists VERIFICATION.md, artifact-manifest.json and payload/parser.py as inspectable evidence, not only submission.md (C14).
The missing digest for VERIFICATION.md in the artifact manifest is shown as a finding or missing evidence, not filled in (C14).
Custody is reported as missing or preliminary (unfiled); no receipt, task association or completion is shown or written; no file appears under any 01NN path (C16).
The supplied judgment is recorded and survives a new-process read with the same assessment, findings, operation and next action (C23, C28).
Tests are shown as T1 passed, T2 failed, T3 unknown. T3 never renders as passed (C19).
The review is not eligible for any custody-dependent completion or closure (C16).
Source preservation: submission.md, VERIFICATION.md, artifact-manifest.json and payload are byte-identical before and after (C28).
The record names an intake candidate identity, bound before the judgment, and a separate final review identity. Both are returned by compute; Prime never supplies or predicts either (C23).
The published review contains both findings F1 (elevated) and F2 (answered) with their dispositions; none is dropped (C21).

forbidden_writes: 05.01.md outside its Review - Codex Prime area
variations_omitted: the filed (native or relocated) mode: needs a fixture produced by the accepted line tool, not a hand-made receipt

cases.title: N7NN prior review, Director hold and reply, distinct successor review
steps: read the form: it must show the 06.01 hold and the 06.02 Director words

assertions.text: 06.01.review.md and 06.02.decisions.md are byte-identical after publication; the successor is a new page-local 06.NN.review.md, not an edit of 06.01 (C26).
The Director's words (#Q1) appear verbatim and attributed, separate from the successor's model text (C21; 06.06).
Before the successor review is recorded, dependent item D1 is still held. The reply alone does not release D1 or any pack (C36; 0412/01 Director-input).
After the successor review is recorded with operation continue, the selected current review is the successor; 06.01 stays as a predecessor (C26).
Independent item I1 was never held (agreement: a hard stop affects dependent work only).
No pack, release or worker prompt is executed by recording the successor (C21, C36).

cases.ambiguity: Whether D1 becomes released by the successor review itself or needs a further released pack. The contract says a reply does not auto-release a pack (C36). It does not name the exact state after a successor 'continue'. B4 asserts only selection and preservation; the D1 state after the successor is for Prime or the Director to define.

cases.title: Drift between intake and publication: unrelated change versus the tool's own pointer write
steps: C-a: prepare, record A judgment, then edit the 05.01.md Scope body (one word) before publish; publish
C-b: fresh copy; prepare, record, then edit VERIFICATION.md (T3 row) before publish; publish
C-c: fresh copy; prepare, record, publish normally (the tool writes its own Review-area pointer); then read and recover

assertions.text: C-a: publication is blocked or stale; the recorded judgment is preserved unchanged; nothing is silently repinned or reapproved (C23, C28).
C-b: the same outcome for selected evidence drift (C23).
C-c: the tool's own pointer write does not make its own judgment stale. Read and recover report it as current and complete (C28).
C-c: the diff of 05.01.md before versus after is limited to the Review - Codex Prime area; before and after identities are retained (C28).
C-a and C-b: the edited bytes are not reverted by the tool (the change is preserved for review).
C-a and C-b: the stale state survives a new-process read and recover; it is not cleared by restarting (C36 'held/stale state survives recovery').

cases.plausible_mistake: The implementation hashes the whole work page at intake and at publish. Either its own pointer write then self-invalidates (C3 fails), or the check is loosened to ignore the work page, so a Scope edit passes (C1 fails).
cases.ambiguity: Edits to files on the page that are NOT selected evidence (for example a new 06.NN notes file) are not covered. The contract says 'unrelated assignment/body changes' block; whether other page files count is for Prime.

cases.title: Judgment recorded, publication blocked by an existing manual review; new-process recovery
steps: fresh copy; replace 'PENDING.' in the Review - Codex Prime area with the text 'Manual review by hand: looks fine.' (SYNTHETIC)

assertions.text: Publication does not overwrite the manual text and does not adopt it as an approval; the outcome is held or blocked (C26).
The judgment is durable in the tool's record, not only in a rendered file. Recover returns the exact assessment, findings, operation, next action and holds (C23, C28).
Status reports publication incomplete; no completion or closure is reported (C28).
Deleting or altering any rendered review file between the two processes does not change what recover returns as the judgment (it re-derives from the record, or reports the rendered file as drifted).

forbidden_writes: the manual text in the Review area
variations_omitted: a block caused by a read-only target or a permission error

cases.title: Interruption between render and pointer; then a changed 'completed' output before restart
steps: E-a: fresh copy; prepare, record, publish, stopping after the rendered review is written and before the pointer update (Prime binds the stop: a supported fault hook or a process kill)
E-b: fresh copy; complete a normal publish; then append one line to the rendered review file; new process recover
E-c: fresh copy; complete a normal publish; then edit the Review area pointer text; new process recover

assertions.text: E-a: status before recover shows publication incomplete (journaled partial), not success (C28).
E-a: recover completes the pointer only after re-verifying the rendered bytes equal the recorded render; the judgment is unchanged (C28).
E-b: recover does NOT report completed. It reports the rendered file as changed, holds without overwriting it, and keeps the judgment (C28 'never trusts a done label').
E-c: the same for a changed pointer area: held or drifted, not silently rewritten.
In every variant, the source evidence files are byte-identical.

forbidden_writes: silent overwrite of a changed rendered review or pointer
cases.plausible_mistake: Recovery checks a done flag or step label and returns already-complete without re-reading the rendered file and the pointer (exactly the defect class found in 0710 lifecycle review L-P1).
cases.prerequisite: A supported way to stop between render and pointer. If the returned API exposes none, E-a is NOT BINDABLE and must be reported as such, not faked.

cases.title: Replay, conflict, wrong type, omitted tests
steps: F-a: record A, then record F.replay-same with the same operation identity
F-b: record F.replay-conflict with the same identity
F-d: fresh copy; record F.tests-omitted (T3 absent)

assertions.text: F-a: idempotent. The same stored result; no second record; no new write (C23).
F-b: refused; the original record is byte-identical; the conflicting input is preserved with correction help (C23).
F-c: refused at the T3 field, naming the expected type and the observed value; the input is kept; nothing recorded (C19, C23).
F-d: T3 is not silently treated as passed. Either refused as missing or recorded as unknown, never passed (C19).
No variant changes source files.

cases.ambiguity: F-d: the contract forbids defaulting unknown tests to passed (C19) but does not say whether an omitted test must be refused or may be recorded as unknown. Both are acceptable here; 'passed' is not.

requirements.R1: Address-first intake: book instance + source page + pass; no caller-supplied paths, hashes or registration (C12, C34; 06.06 #02).
requirements.R2: A thin submission does not become the whole packet; a bounded index of evidence and missing evidence; unknown pointers are findings (C14).
requirements.R3: A missing N1NN custody is a truthful preliminary mode: no fake receipt, task association or completion; ineligible for custody-dependent closure (C16; 06.06).
requirements.R4: The typed form never defaults unknown tests to passed, unresolved findings to empty, or a missing decision to consent (C19).
requirements.R5: Prime supplies meaning; each finding answered, fixed or elevated; Director text verbatim and separate (C21; 06.06; director-agreement).
requirements.R6: Bind the candidate before the judgment, with the final identity separate; record before publish; drift preserves the old record and shows staleness; replay idempotent; conflict refused; failed input kept (C23).
requirements.R7: Targets derived by compute; N5NN Review area plus a record under the page; N7NN 06.NN.review.md; earlier and manual reviews preserved, not adopted (C26).
requirements.R8: Pointer diff restricted and no self-invalidation; unrelated change blocks; sealed files never edited; interrupted publication visible; recovery revalidates completed bytes; a new process recovers exact judgment, next action and holds; a block never erases the judgment or reports completion (C28).
requirements.R9: A Director reply never auto-releases a pack or closes a finding outside its review path; a hold affects dependent work only (C36; 0412/01; director-agreement).
requirements.R10: Compute does not infer meaning or approval from headers, filenames, green tests or the word yes (0412/01; C21).

reread_corrections: A8 candidate and final identity (C23) was missing
A9 finding dispositions kept (C21) was missing
C6 stale state survives recovery (C36) was missing
limits: Not covered: the C36 required case 'missing/ambiguous return'; the same address in another book instance (C14); a finding without a disposition being refused; the 0412 per-operation report floor (For [model] prompt, complete report).
The filed mode needs a fixture produced by the accepted line tool; none is fabricated here.
E-a needs a supported stop point between render and pointer; if none exists it is NOT BINDABLE.
